newsitem.title: USA: Samsonite says Carl Icahn, ex-chairman to sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Samsonite says Carl Icahn, ex-chairman to sell shares.

text.p: Samsonite Corp. said Friday investor Carl Icahn and former Chairman Steven Green plan to sell as much as 4.8 million common shares they own in the company, greatly reducing their holdings.
The Denver, Colo., luggage company said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission that it will itself sell an additional 3 million shares in the offering.
The company said Icahn planned to sell up to 3.14 million shares, which will reduce his stake to 1.57 percent, from 21.54 percent.
Icahn was in the news last month for proposing a slate of nominees to run as directors of RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp., in a second attempt to influence RJR to spin off its Nabisco food business.

Green, who resigned in May to pursue personal business interests, plans to sell up to 1.68 million shares, which will cut his stake to 168,515 shares or less than 1 percent of the total outstanding, from 15.35 percent.
It will not receive proceeds from any sale by the two investors, the company said.
The company said it expects to raise net proceeds of $105.7 million from the shares it plans to offer and will use it to repay debt.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters led by Merrill Lynch & Co.
